paragraphs: On Saturday morning, the Explorers waited in the school gallery beside the front door. The gallery was a long hall with many photos of the school on the walls. Some photos were old, and some were new. The Explorers wanted to walk the old town trail. "Where is Teacher Kim?" asked Lily. "She is late," said Leo. "Did anybody see Teacher Kim's car?" "No," said May. "Look at the advertisement beside the door." "It says, 'Trail Walk, Saturday, nine o'clock.'"

At five past nine, Mia came in and put her closed umbrella in the corner. Her shoes made small dark marks on the floor near the door. There was a small sign near the door: "WET FLOOR." "Sorry, I am late," said Mia. "The road was very slow today." "Did you bring the camera?" asked Leo. "Yes," said Mia. "And I have an extra battery in my bag." "Good," said Leo. "I left my hat at home." "Should I go back for it?"

Then Teacher Kim came in with a big bag. She put the bag on a table and took out a small box of papers. Her shoes made a small sound on the floor. She looked at the window, and the street outside was empty. "Good morning, everybody," she said. "Leo, you do not need your hat today." "Why not?" asked Leo. "Because we have a small change in the plan," said Teacher Kim. Lily looked at the window and then at her friends.

"Are we still going to the trail?" asked May. "Not this morning," said Teacher Kim. "The trail is not good for walking today." "Let us relax here and look at the photos in the gallery." "We can still do something useful." "Lily, would you like to write an article about the gallery for the blog?"

"Yes, please," said Lily. She sat on a chair beside the window and opened her notebook. Leo and May walked along the wall and looked at the old photos. Mia took her camera and began to take pictures of the photos. Mia looked at her umbrella in the corner. "It is still wet," she said. "Maybe we can walk the trail next Saturday." "Maybe," said Teacher Kim. "We will see." Then she sat down and opened her own notebook.
text.summary: The Explorers wait in the school gallery for a trail walk. Mia comes in with a closed umbrella, and Teacher Kim changes the plan, but nobody says why. The clues show the reason.
